findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards log output
findings.body: TestLogger.FromContext returns a brand-new TestLogger instead of the receiver or a child linked to the receiver. Since LoggerMiddleware now logs via logger.FromContext(ctx).Info, any log emitted in tests using TestLogger will be recorded on an object the test cannot inspect, making assertions on logged messages impossible. Return the same TestLogger, or a child that propagates recorded logs back to the original fake.

findings.title: Metrics middleware mutates a shared instance when applied
findings.body: NewMetricsMiddleware creates one MetricsMiddleware and the returned ClientMiddlewareFunc sets imw.next and returns that same instance. If this middleware is ever applied more than once, for example when reusing a middleware slice to build multiple decorators, the shared next field will be overwritten and earlier decorator chains will route requests to the wrong downstream client. Create a per-chain wrapper or avoid mutating shared state.

findings.title: Adding FromContext to Logger is a breaking interface change
findings.body: The exported Logger interface gains a new FromContext method. Any existing implementation of this interface outside this package, including downstream forks, enterprise code, or tests, will no longer compile. If this package is intended to be implementable outside the repository, this should be treated as an API break or introduced in a compatible way.
